description: This is a test source file containing unit tests for the Mattermost server API, specifically for system endpoints such as ping, audits, email testing, support packet generation, site URL testing, database recycling, cache invalidation, logs retrieval, server busy status, redirect location, and onboarding completion.

methods.name: TestGetPing
methods.description: Tests the /system/ping endpoint for healthy and unhealthy status, feature flags, and full status responses.

methods.name: TestGetAudits
methods.description: Tests retrieval of audit logs with different parameters and permissions.

methods.name: TestEmailTest
methods.description: Tests email configuration and sending capabilities for different user roles and settings.

methods.name: TestGenerateSupportPacket
methods.description: Tests support packet generation functionality under various permission and license conditions.

methods.name: supportPacketFileName
methods.description: Generates expected support packet filename based on timestamp and customer name.

methods.name: TestSiteURLTest
methods.description: Tests the site URL validation endpoint for different URL scenarios and user roles.

methods.name: TestDatabaseRecycle
methods.description: Tests the database recycle endpoint for permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestInvalidateCaches
methods.description: Tests cache invalidation endpoint with permission checks.

methods.name: TestGetLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieval of server logs with different parameters and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestDownloadLogs
methods.description: Tests downloading server logs as admin and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestPostLog
methods.description: Tests posting logs with developer mode enabled/disabled and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetAnalyticsOld
methods.description: Tests retrieval of old analytics data, websocket connection counts, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestS3TestConnection
methods.description: Tests S3 connection configuration and authentication.

methods.name: TestSupportedTimezones
methods.description: Verifies supported timezones list matches configuration.

methods.name: TestRedirectLocation
methods.description: Tests URL redirection logic, caching, and length restrictions.

methods.name: TestSetServerBusy
methods.description: Tests setting server busy status with permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestSetServerBusyInvalidParam
methods.description: Tests invalid parameters for setting server busy status.

methods.name: TestClearServerBusy
methods.description: Tests clearing server busy status with permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetServerBusy
methods.description: Tests retrieving server busy status with permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestServerBusy503
methods.description: Tests server response when busy for user, team, and channel searches.

methods.name: TestPushNotificationAck
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment of push notifications, session property updates, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestCompleteOnboarding
methods.description: Tests onboarding completion, plugin installation, and permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestGetAppliedSchemaMigrations
methods.description: Tests retrieval of applied schema migrations with permission restrictions.

methods.name: TestCheckHasNilFields
methods.description: Checks if struct fields are correctly identified as nil or set.
